deck: HOW 192 PRACTITIONERS LAUNCH AN MC AUTHORITY, POST THE $75,000 BOND AND PROSPECT NICHE SHIPPERS
HOW THEY VET CARRIERS, PRICE THE SPREAD, FUND THE FLOAT AND DEFEND AGAINST DOUBLE BROKERING
site_ui.lead: Freight brokerage operators describe the business as a spread trade financed like a bank: contract the shipper's rate, buy the truck cheaper, and fund the gap between quick-paying carriers and slow-paying shippers.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, from authority filing and the $75,000 surety bond to cold calling, accessorials, double brokering and cargo claims. Every metric, pro-tip, operator gate and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.
chapters: The Business Case and Launch Roadmap
Broker Authority, Registration and the Transparency Fight
Quote to Cash: Pricing, Load Operations and Payment
Equipment Niches: Van, Reefer, Flatbed, Heavy Haul and Drayage
Double Brokering and Freight Fraud Defense
flow: Apply through FMCSA's registration system, pay $300 per authority type, file a BOC-3 process agent covering every operating state, then check SAFER for the MC number about 24 hours later.
Post $75,000 via a BMC-84 surety bond or BMC-85 trust; credit-based premiums run $900 to $9,000, and a shortfall gets 7 business days to restore before suspension.
Pick a narrow niche like steel, lumber or machinery, scout shippers with satellite recon and help-wanted pages, and star 50 rows before dialing toward five great clients.
Require a clean SAFER snapshot: authorized status, matching phone, more than zero trucks and a known authority grant date, while screening for double-brokering red flags.
Contract the shipper rate, buy the truck cheaper at roughly $100 to $600 per load, and post loads with driver candy: light, no tarp, quick pay and price shown.
Line up funding before volume, since 10 loads a week puts a new desk $40,000 out of pocket by week four, and know break-even loads before the owner earns anything.

tagline: Big Money. Small Teams. No Bullshit.
title: FREIGHT BROKERAGE
